alternatives.option: Extend generic payroll automation for lembur
pros: Less new UI and route surface
cons: Generic path inputs full Venus amount, not shortfall
It does not fill charge job dimensions

alternatives.option: Clone beras shortfall path into a dedicated lembur adjustment path
pros: Matches existing proven shortfall and charge job pattern
cons: Adds a new route/dialog/template or parameterized template

alternatives.option: Parameterize beras path into generic shortfall adjustment
cons: Higher refactor risk in a dirty worktree
alternatives.verdict: Good later refactor; not first implementation.

pitfalls.issue: Using full Venus lembur amount instead of selisih
pitfalls.mitigation: Dedicated prepareLemburAdjustmentData must override component.venusAmount to max(0, venus - millware).

pitfalls.issue: Duplicate filter skips wrong amount signature
pitfalls.mitigation: Existing AD signature must compare against AL0019 + shortfall amount, not original Venus total.
Dry-run should require chargeJob for lembur adjustment and diagnostics should skip rows without chargeJob.
